strings.privacy.description: Naka la pdff di toppee say jumtukaay: amul compte, amul téere bu ñuy denc, amul pub ak jëndu xibaar.

strings.legal.accessibility.title: Mën a duggal
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Waxyu pdff ci mën a duggal: WCAG 2.2 level AA target, ay yëngu-yëngu, ay xët yu ñu xam ak naka nga mën a xamal benn lëndëm-jëf.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Ku nekk war na a mën a jëfëndikoo pdff, ba ci ñi gëmadi walla ñi gisadi, ñi déggadi, walla ñi am lëndëm-jëf ci yaram walla ci xel.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Standardu target
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdff dafa bëgg a topp Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA, standardu winji international W3C. Level bi dafay àggal laaj yu Standardu Gbeukluu Canada ci Mën a Duggal ci Web, standardu Europe EN 301 549 ak Section 508 ci États-Unis, ñuy wax ci WCAG 2.0 walla 2.1 level AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Nanu mel ci mën a duggal
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdff mën na a duggal ci wàllu WCAG 2.2 level AA: xët yu ñu xam ñu ngi leen di lim ci suuf. Waxyu bi dafa dëgër ci seetlu bi ñu def ci 2 Oktoob 2026, jëfëndikoo outilu automático (axe, Lighthouse) ak seetlu bu nit (clavier, contrast, zoom, wax). Amul bénn seetlu bu moom boppam bu ñu def ba léegi.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Lu nekk ci biir
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Site bi lépp day liggéey ak clavier, ak lien “Dem na ci biir” ak wër bu wone ci element bi ñuy def. Contrastu mbind mi mu ngi tollo ak 4.5:1. Xët yi ci liggéey bi (yeb, njàngal, naxari) ñu ngi leen di wax lëkkalikaay mbind. Limu demb bi mën na soppiku amul drag and drop, jëfëndikoo bouton. Site bi dafay topp settingu “reduce motion” bu sa aparèy: animation yi day taxaw bu baax. Xët yi day des di mën a jàng ci zoom 400% ak ci téléphone. Làkku xët bu nekk ñu ngi koy wax, te leneen ak leneen lakk Arab day génne ñaari wàll.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Xët yu ñu xam
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Amul setting boobu, animation yi (fond, ring, format ticker) day dem rekk; ticker bi day taxaw su fekkee nga def ci sa xol walla clavier. Ring bu am animation ci pageu kër bi day liggéey ak souris walla baam; day wone rekk, te limu format yi mu wone mën na ko am itam ni mbind ci page bi. Làkk yi ñu tekki ak machine mën nañu am ay njuumte. Te itam, mën a duggalu demb bi ñu defar dafa yam ci bu njëkk bi: pdff du yokk tagu mën a duggal ci PDF bu amul benn.
